data.one_liner: Renders PDF pages to bitmap images using native iOS and Android renderers.
data.what_it_does: The package opens a PDF file, lets you query page sizes, and renders any page to a Uint8List bitmap. It works via platform channels and supports scaling and background color options.
use_when: You need to display PDF content as images in a Flutter app
You require fast native rendering on Android and iOS
You want to avoid heavy PDF parsing libraries
avoid_when: You need interactive PDF features like text selection or annotations
You target platforms other than Android/iOS (e.g., web, desktop)
strengths: Simple API for opening, rendering, and closing pages
weaknesses: Only works on Android and iOS
Requires higher minSdk (24) and recent Flutter/Dart versions
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, ensure Android minSdk >=24 and AGP >=9, iOS deployment target >=13, and configure platform-specific permissions if needed
